candidates.title: Pakistan security forces kill 18 terrorists in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan
candidates.excerpt: According to Radio Pakistan, the security forces “killed 13 Fitna al-Khawarij terrorists” during an intelligence-based operation in North Waziristan district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

candidates.title: 7 policemen injured in attack in northwest Pakistan
candidates.excerpt: A search operation has been launched, and an investigation into the incident is underway

candidates.title: Ex-Telangana home guard working as bike-taxi driver in Andhra held in chain-snatching case
candidates.excerpt: Police say he used the job to move around and target women walking alone in six cities; a woman who allegedly sold the jewellery is also arrested

candidates.title: SRFTI students demand Vaishnaw's safety assurance as classes remain suspended over campus violence
candidates.excerpt: On October 4, the campus again witnessed a scuffle during a protest organised by members of the Bangiya Hindu Jagaran Mancha. Some of the agitators tried to break open the institute's gate when they were stopped by police.

candidates.title: Water Shortage Sparks Protest In K. Kotapadu Village
candidates.excerpt: Women residents of K. Kotapadu protested over a four-day drinking water shortage and demanded immediate restoration of supply.

candidates.title: Humayun Kabir Says Will Quit Politics In Protest Against Rejinagar Bypoll 'Loot'
candidates.excerpt: "Residents of Rejinagar were not allowed to vote... If I can't protest against this injustice, what can I do through politics?... After Durga Puja, I will hold a meeting and apologise to the people. I will end my political career," said Humayun Kabir.

candidates.title: Khadgamala Archana Held for Modi at Indrakeeladri
candidates.excerpt: Special prayers, including a Khadgamala archana, were performed at the Sri Kanaka Durga temple atop Indrakeeladri in Vijayawada on Wednesday for Prime Minister Narendra Modi, marking 25 years of his public life.
